description: Curated, NON-AUTHORITATIVE navigation catalog for the ICN Development Control Center. It names the seven long-lived programs and the rules used to group live work under them. It holds no status: every PR, session, worktree and decision shown under a program is read live from its owner (git, GitHub, process table, tmux, icn-ops registry, host records). A program with no matched work is shown as 'no matched work observed', never as inactive. Goals and owners are shown only where a source is named here; otherwise they display as unassigned. Repositories not named here (for example private local stores) are classified by keyword over their store name, branch and task text.
